title: Ha Long on route 2
summary: One boat from the Ha Long passenger port. Route 2 lands at Ti Top, Sung Sot, and Luon on one shared clock of 5–6 hours.

stops.name: Ti Top Island
stops.note: Land at Ti Top on the port's route 2 boat.

approach.note: The same route 2 boat goes on to the next landing.

stops.name: Sung Sot Cave
stops.note: Continue to Sung Sot on the same boat.

approach.note: The same route 2 boat goes on to the next landing.

stops.name: Luon Cave
stops.note: End at Luon, still on that route 2 boat.

seoTitle: Ha Long in a day — route 2, five to six hours
seoDescription: A Ha Long day on route 2: Ti Top, Sung Sot, and Luon together in 5–6 hours. Time ashore at each landing is Check on arrival.
